$comment: The navigation of source.riffpress.com, in one place: site-nav.js stamps it into every page written by hand and site-shell.js into every generated one. Each entry of sections is one link in the header, in this order; its children are its section bar, and a child with children of its own is a group in that bar. href is the page's path on the site as written, before developers-site.js moves the reference from developers/ to the host's root. host names the host, for the title. bar: false keeps a page out of the section bar while it still belongs to the section, for its breadcrumbs. root marks the section that is the host's home: the wordmark leads to it, and its page is titled with the host's name alone. ordered gives a group's pages a previous and next link. footer lists each group's links by key, or as label and href for a page off the site.
